job.description:
Generative AI Engineer
Tessellate Labs
Location: Bengaluru, India (Hybrid)

About us
Tessellate Labs builds document-intelligence software for banks and insurers.

About the role
You will build retrieval-augmented assistants that answer questions over loan agreements and KYC documents.

What you will do
- Write and version prompts, and measure their effect with offline evaluation sets.
- Integrate LLM features into production services within agreed latency and cost budgets.
- Add guardrails, citation checks and fallbacks so the system fails safely.
- Own features end to end, from design notes to production monitoring.

What we are looking for
- 2-5 years of relevant experience
- B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Must-have skills: Python, LangChain, RAG, Vector databases, Prompt engineering, FastAPI

Good to have
- Qdrant, LLM evaluation, Docker
